name: A small building  on a rocky hillside, with a group of figures and the bay at left
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of a house and awning on a rocky hillside, with figures on a pathway and others in a group by piled-up rocks; for less complete versions of this composition see E.2142-1928 and E.2152-1928.
